sources.location: doi:10.1016/j.jasrep.2023.104238 (J Archaeol Sci Rep 52:104238); full text read from Cambridge repository copy https://www.repository.cam.ac.uk/bitstreams/5c49faba-3144-41fb-91f6-68ca910d4c21/download
https://zenodo.org/api/records/7858995 and /7861359 (Experimental_annotation.csv lists only JORD8; P0578 absent)

claims.evidence: LC-MS/MS SAP analysis assigned SM4,5,10,23,26 to genus Capra (Results, LC-MS/MS sequencing). Genus level only.
SM18 'either Capra sp. or Antilopinae' - family Bovidae is the lowest common taxon.
SM12 placed in subfamily Antilopinae (tentatively Nanger/Gazella).
Raw header 'Orbitrap Exploris 480' for EXPL2 files; consistent with paper (Tryps-IN on Exploris 480).
Raw header 'Q Exactive HF-X - Orbitrap MS' for JORD12/JORD23. Paper text would imply Exploris for Tryps-IN; raw data prevails.

summary.txt/mqpar.xml: Oxidation (M); Gln->pyro-Glu; Glu->pyro-Glu; Hydroxyproline; Deamidation (NQ); Acetyl (Protein N-term). Hydroxyproline written as Oxidation UNIMOD:35 TA=P (MaxQuant Hydroxyproline = Oxidation (P)).
Wet-lab digest with Promega trypsin; MaxQuant enzyme Trypsin/P semispecific (search setting only).
File names contain DDA; shotgun proteomics experiment type.

Deposited RAW with no sample identity (not in MaxQuant run, paper, Zenodo). Row kept with source name 'P0578 (sample unidentified)'; organism Capra is the PRIDE project-level field only; organism part/stage/sex/strain not available. Could be SM8 (paper: carnivore) - unverified, so not asserted.
Raw headers: Exploris 'HCD Collision Energy (%) = 30'; HF-X 'Fragmentation_HCD 28 eV' (reported by independent reviewer round 1).

limitations: Species ID is for tentative palaeoproteomic taxa; sex, age, developmental stage, strain not available.
Reduction/alkylation not stated for bone samples and no fixed modification in search: not available.
Project-level PRIDE protocol says ABC extractions on QE HF-X and Tryps-IN on Exploris 480; raw headers put JORD12/JORD23 on HF-X although paper Table 1 treats all eight as Tryps-IN.
PRIDE structured instrument field lists only Q Exactive; organism field lists Capra sp.
Row 8 (P0578): sample identity unknown; organism Capra is a project-level fallback and may be wrong (possibly SM8, carnivore).
Extraction method (ABC vs Tryps-IN) is not annotated; JORD12/JORD23 on HF-X may be ABC extracts per paper Methods.
No factor value: no designed comparison; biological replicate = 1 for each distinct bone.
